name: Thieves Of Dingirra
source: In this strategy/RPG game, assume the role of the Master Thief, establish a Thieves Guild in Dingirra, recruit NPCs, grow in power, delve into your companions’ pasts, and maybe even develop romantic relationships with them. All while aiming to fully conquer the town of Dingirra.
translation: 在这款策略/角色扮演游戏中，扮演大盗的角色，在丁吉拉建立盗贼公会，招募NPC，增强力量，探究同伴的过去，甚至可能与他们发展浪漫关系。目标是完全征服丁吉拉镇。
